title: CoReMem: Cost-Internalizing Memory for Successive Coding Tasks with Prospective Valuation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17316v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents tackle successive tasks on an evolving repository, carrying forward edits and writing memory before the next task is known. Selecting memory for unknown next tasks requires balancing future usefulness against the costs of writing and reading it. The actor must also decide when acting on available memory saves effort as the task unfolds. We introduce Coding-Repository Memory (CoReMem), a cost-internalizing framework that guides memory design and actor adaptation through measured memory value on the next task. Prospective segment valuation compares runs of the next task with and without individual trajectory segments from the same inherited repository state, guiding a compact memory built around anchors: repository locations and executable checks. translated_title: CoReMem：面向连续编码任务、基于前瞻估值且将成本内化的记忆框架
translated_abstract: 编码智能体在不断演进的代码库上处理连续任务，需要在下一个任务未知之前继承此前的编辑内容并写入记忆。为未知任务选择记忆，需要在未来有用性与写入和读取记忆的成本之间进行权衡。执行者还需要决定在任务展开过程中，何时利用可用记忆来节省工作量。我们提出了编码库记忆（CoReMem），这是一个将成本内化的框架，通过在下一个任务上测量记忆的实际价值，来指导记忆设计与执行者自适应。前瞻性片段估值通过对比在相同继承代码库状态下，使用与不使用单个轨迹片段执行下一个任务的效果，指导构建一个围绕“锚点”（即代码库位置和可执行检查）的紧凑记忆。执行者自适应则在有记忆与无记忆的 rollout 组内估计在策略记忆价值，并使用一种奖励机制：优先考虑任务是否解决，同时在成功运行中惩罚步数过多。
tldr: 该论文提出CoReMem框架，通过前瞻性片段估值将记忆的读写成本内化，围绕代码库位置与可执行检查构建紧凑记忆，并让编码智能体在连续任务中自适应地学习何时利用记忆以提升解决率并降低步数成本。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CoReMem, a cost-internalizing framework that uses prospective segment valuation to build compact memory around repository anchors and executable checks, and adaptively teaches coding agents when to leverage memory across successive coding tasks.
